newsitem.title: UK: Bakery Services plans July AIM float.
newsitem.headline: Bakery Services plans July AIM float.

text.p: In-store bakery operator Bakery Services Plc said on Wednesday it planned to float on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market and hoped to raise about 780,000 stg via a placing.
The company said it would use the funds to reduce gearing and provide new capital to expand its business.
Dealings in Bakery Services shares are expected to start on July 7 following the placing at 3p per share.
The company is expected to be valued around 2.2 million stg.
Bakery Services, through its wholly owned subsidiary Inbake, operates bakeries in UK food retailing stores such as the Co-op and Roys (Wroxham) Ltd.
The company said some its bakeries provided a 'theatre' whereby customers could view the baking process and the aroma from its freshly baked products promoted impulse buying.
The company made a pre-tax profit of 94,000 stg for the year ended March 31 1996.
